title: Victorian rental minimum standards
description: The 15 categories of minimum standards a Victorian rental must meet when advertised and before the renter moves in. Summarised from Consumer Affairs Victoria.

sources.title: New changes to the rental laws

items.title: Washbasin and shower or bath with reasonable hot and cold water
items.detail: Showers need a 3-star water rating where one can be fitted.

items.title: Modern switchboard with circuit breakers and safety switches (RCDs)
A fixed, energy-efficient heater in the main living area
Cooking and food preparation area, sink with hot and cold water, stovetop with 2 or more burners
Hot and cold water in the laundry
Natural light by day and artificial light at night in rooms and hallways
Working deadlocks or qualifying locks on external entry doors
All rooms free from mould and damp caused by the building structure
Working toilet in a separate room, connected to sewer or an approved system
Adequate ventilation in habitable rooms, bathrooms, toilets and laundry
Vermin-proof rubbish and recycling bins that meet council requirements
External windows that open have working latches
Curtains or blinds in bedrooms and living areas that block light and give privacy
Anchors fitted on all corded internal blinds and curtains
Keep records showing the property met the standards (from 13 October 2026)
